paite: Na lak uah kuapeuh in midang toh thubuai neita le uchin, misiangthoute ma a tun lou in, midiktatloute ma ah na tun ngam ding ua hia?
heading: Khristiante Kihek Thu
english: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?

paite: Ahihleh misiangthoute'n khovel tung a vaihawm ding ahi chih na thei kei ua hia? Khovel mite tung a bawn vaihawm ding na hih uleh, thil neupente leng ngaihtuah tak lou na hi ua hia?
english: Don’t you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

paite: Tulai damsung thute gen louh angelte nangawn i vaihawm ding uh ahi chih na thei kei ua hia?
english: Don’t you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?

paite: Huchi in tulai damsung thute ngaihtuah ding na neih un bangziak a saptuamte ngaihniam pente ngaihtuahsak na hi ua?
english: If then you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?

paite: Na zumna ding un ka gen ahi. A-unaute kal a thu hihpuk thei mipil, khat bek na lak uah na mu kei ua ahi ding maw?
english: I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?

paite: Unau in a-unau mah ginglou mite vaihawmna a atut zawk nak!
english: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!

paite: Hilou ahi, hiai na diklouhna khat uh ahi pah hi, thubuai na kineih tuah nak uh. Bangziak a dikloupi a hihna na thuak zaw lou? Bang achia kizangsak zaw mai lou oi?
english: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?

paite: Hilou ahi, noumau ngei in na unaute uh tung ah leng na hihdik kei ua, na zangsak uhi.
english: No, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers.

paite: Ahihleh midiktatloute'n Pathian lalgam aluah kei ding uh chih na thei kei ua hia? Khem in om kei un, kingaihhatte, milim bete, angkawmte leh mihukte leh tokohukte,
english: Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male prostitutes, nor homosexuals,

paite: gutate, mihuaihamte, zukhamhatte, salhhatte leh lepgute'n Pathian lalgam aluah kei ding uh.
english: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.

paite: Huan noute khenkhat huchibang na hi uh; himahleh Toupa Jesu Khrist min in leh i Pathian Kha ah siansak na hita ua, hihsiangthou na hita ua, siamtang na hita uhi.
english: Some of you were such, but you were washed. You were sanctified. You were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.

paite: "Thil bangkim hih kei a ding in asiang a," himahleh thil bangkim hih ahoihkim kei, "Thil bangkim hih kei a ding in asiang a," himahleh bangmah sikha ding in ka kiphal kei hi.
heading: Pumpi Hiangte Zatna Dik
english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.

paite: "Nek dingte gilpi a ahi a, gilpi leng nek ding a ahi," himahleh Pathian in ahihmang tuaktuak ding. Huan pumpi pen kingaihna ding ahi kei a, Toupa a ding ahi; Toupa leng pumpi a ding ahi;
english: “Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods,” but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.

paite: Pathian in misi lak a kipan Toupa akaithou a, eite leng athilhihtheihna in hon kaithou sam ding hi.
english: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.

paite: Na pumpi uh Khrist hiang ahi chih na thei kei ua hia? Khrist hiangte laksak in kizuak hiang ding peuh in ka bawl dia hia?
english: Don’t you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!

paite: Bawl lou hial ding. Ahihleh kizuak zop amah toh pum khat ahi uh chih na thei kei ua hia? "Anih un sapum khat ahi ding uh," achi ngal a.
english: Or don’t you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, “The two”, he says, “will become one flesh.”

paite: Toupa zop bel amah toh kha pum khat ahi uhi.
english: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.

paite: Kingaih taisan un. Mihing thilhihkhelh chiteng pumpi polam ah ahi; mingaih hat in bel amah pumpi tung ah thil ahihkhial hi.
english: Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.

paite: Ahihleh na pumpi uh, na sung ua om Pathian kiang a kipan a na muh uh, Kha Siangthou tempul ahi chih na thei kei ua hia? Noumau a leng na hi kei ua,
english: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,

paite: man a leisa na hih ziak un, na pumpi uh leh na kha Pathian a mah in, Pathian pahtawi un.
english: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.
